articles.title: Indonesia-France Film Lab Unveils Six Projects as Paris Readies First Southeast Asia Co-Production Forum (EXCLUSIVE)
articles.summary: Six Indonesian projects, each from a director-producer pairing working on a debut or sophomore feature, have been chosen for the 2026 Indonesia-France Film Lab X MTN Lab, which runs Nov. 25-30 in Yogyakarta as part of JAFF Market.
body: “Indonesian filmmakers have never lacked stories. What they have lacked is structured access to international partners,” said Fauzan Zidni, chairman of BPI. “BPI is committed to working with the Ministry of Culture, the French Embassy, CNC and our industry associations to make sure these projects get made.”

French script consultant Eric Collins leads the story development strand, working with each team individually to sharpen each project’s artistic vision and international prospects. A separate two-day industry workshop covers development, financing, international distribution and the workings of the French film business. It is led by producers Vincent Wang of House On Fire and Thibaut Amri of Avant La Nuit, along with Sébastien Chesneau of sales company Cercamon.

articles.title: Golden Globes Predictions: 170 Films and 475 Actors Vie for Nominations as Voting Gets Underway. Who Will Make the Cut?
articles.summary: Variety Awards Circuit section is the home for all awards news and related content throughout the year, featuring the following: the official predictions for the upcoming Oscars, Emmys, Grammys and Tony Awards ceremonies, curated by Variety chief awards editor Clayton Davis.
body: Golden Globes Predictions Commentary (Updated: Nov. 24, 2026): Golden Globe voting is underway! Here’s the breakdown of all the submissions.

Eighty-eight films were submitted for best motion picture (drama), and 43 are competing for best motion picture (musical or comedy). Among the drama submissions are Christopher Nolan’s “The Odyssey” and Denis Villeneuve’s “Dune: Part Three.” The musical or comedy field also includes Destin Daniel Cretton’s “Spider-Man: Brand New Day” and David Fincher’s “The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth.”

In the lead acting races, the drama category for best actor has 69 submissions representing 64 performers with Brad Pitt in contention for “Heart of the Beast,” alongside Robert Pattinson for “Primetime.” The musical or comedy category features 32 submissions from 31 performers, including Tom Holland for “Spider-Man: Brand New Day” and Ryan Gosling for “Project Hail Mary.”

articles.title: Oscars Visual Effects Top 20 Revealed: Disney Leads With Four Titles as ‘The Odyssey,’ ‘Ramayana,’ ‘Dune: Part Three’ and ‘Wildwood’ Make the Cut (EXCLUSIVE)
articles.summary: The Oscar race for visual effects is down to 20, and the road to the 99th Academy Awards runs through Ithaca, Motunui and a galaxy far, far away. The Academy’s Visual Effects Branch notified the artisans behind the 20 films advancing to the next round ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday.
body: Other VFX finalists include “Backrooms,” “Digger,” “Godzilla Minus Zero,” “The Mosquito Bowl,” “Project Hail Mary” and “Spider-Man: Brand New Day.”
The Academy does not release the top 20 externally and declines to comment or confirm which films advanced.

Disney leads the confirmed titles with four. Alongside “Avengers: Doomsday,” the studio lands Jon Favreau’s “Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu,” 20th Century Studios’ “Whalefall” and Thomas Kail’s live-action “Moana,” which brings Dwayne Johnson back as the demigod Maui.

Skydance (formerly Warner Bros. Discovery) took three of the spots: “Dune: Part Three,” Alejandro G. Iñárritu’s Tom Cruise-led “Digger” and Craig Gillespie’s “Supergirl” from former DC Studios heads James Gunn and Peter Safran. But the studio also sees four contenders fall short.

articles.title: Substance released at concert could be linked to robberies, police say
articles.summary: Police are investigating a possible link between the Co-op Live evacuation and reported robberies.
body: An "unknown substance" that prompted a mass evacuation at a rap concert may be linked to robberies and stolen jewellery at the venue, police have said.
More than 12,000 people were evacuated from Manchester's Co-op Live during a performance by US rapper Don Toliver on Sunday.
One person was taken to hospital and 88 others were treated at the scene after concertgoers reported a "horrible smell" and some people "coughing up blood".
Greater Manchester Police (GMP) said officers received nine reports of jewellery being stolen during the concert but no arrests had been made and the substance had not yet been identified.

articles.title: Bake Off winner crowned after high-stakes final
articles.summary: Judge Nigella Lawson describes the three finalists as "sensational" bakers.
body: Moyin Odeniran said he was "in shock" after being crowned the winner of the 17th series of The Great British Bake Off.
The 22-year-old from Loughton, Essex, described it as a "very busy time" as he juggled competing in the Channel 4 baking competition with completing his university studies.
Despite his dissertation being due a month after filming wrapped, Odeniran achieved a first in his political economy degree at King's College London.
He beat fellow finalists Tom Whittaker, from West Yorkshire, and Birmingham student Mo Mahir to the title in Tuesday night's episode.

articles.title: ‘Dancing With the Stars’ Finalist Connor Wood Has Already Won: “I Feel Really Good”
articles.summary: The 31-year-old comedian has made it to the finale of the dance competition series show, even though he never quite expected it: "I really can't put my finger on why this clicked for me, but I leaned in a lot."
body: Comedian and podcaster Connor Wood has become a bit of a fan favorite on this season of Dancing With the Stars. “If we’re not in practice, I feel like I’m missing practice,” the 31-year-old tells The Hollywood Reporter on a Zoom call. It’s a rare rainy day in Los Angeles, and the season 35 contestant is finding a second to rest amidst crazy rehearsal schedules.
“I have been really intentional about my life and making sure I don’t ever work really hard,” he says, cheekily. “This has changed that completely, flipped it on its head.”
Heading into the final episode, he and the dancers are working with six hours a day of rehearsal to get themselves in prime condition. “Every minute of that is necessary for the show,” he notes.
Below, Wood speaks with THR about heading into the DWTS finale, the reaction to his viral Jennifer Lawrence moment and dealing with the online hate.

articles.title: 'The Rings of Power' Director on the "Terrifying Responsibility" of Tackling Middle-earth's Darkest Moment
articles.summary: The Rings of Power director Stefan Schwartz discusses his approach to Sauron's forging of the One Ring and working closely with Charlie Vickers.
body: Editor's note: The below interview contains spoilers for The Rings of Power Season 3 Episode 7.

Before Episode 7's Prime Video premiere, Collider spoke with acclaimed filmmaker Stefan Schwartz ( Dexter, The Americans, Star City ), who joins The Rings of Power 's directing team for Season 3, about the daunting task of bringing such an iconic Middle-earth moment to life, the surprising element that informed the scene's major beats, the experience of working closely with Vickers during the sequence's week-long shoot, and more.
COLLIDER: What was your reaction to finding out that Episode 7 was going to be screened in theaters and that fans were going to have the opportunity to see everything play out on the big screen?
STEFAN SCHWARTZ: I was super excited. In fact, last night I went to my local cinema and saw it with probably 200 people, and it was packed full. There was cheering at the end.

articles.title: One Of Star Trek's Best Spock Episodes Is Hidden In The Series You Never Watched
articles.summary: Star Trek: The Animated Series is essential viewing for Trekkies, not least of all because it features an all-timer of a Spock-forward episode.
body: One of the best Spock-forward episodes of the "Star Trek" franchise, "Yesteryear," is hidden deep in "Star Trek: The Animated Series." The show ran for two seasons from 1973 to 1974, and it is, in some ways, superior to "Star Trek: The Original Series." At the very least, because it's a 30-minute program, it's the more efficient show, having to tell similarly expansive sci-fi stories in half the time of "The Original Series."

Case in point: "Yesteryear" sees Kirk (William Shatner) and Spock (Leonard Nimoy) conducting time travel experiments with the Guardian of Forever, a living, stone-like time portal previously seen in the franchise-changing "Original Series" episode "The City on the Edge of Forever." After a sojourn to the past, though, something seems to have gone wrong with causality, and history has altered. No one can remember Spock, and an Andorian man has replaced him as the first officer of the USS Enterprise. This is a new, unfamiliar timeline.

articles.title: Why Joey From The Further Mis-Adventures Of Cliff Booth Looks So Familiar
articles.summary: The opening moments of The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth have a character named Joey, and if he looked familiar, we know where you've seen him before.
body: "The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth" brings back Brad Pitt as the stuntman from Quentin Tarantino's "Once Upon a Time in Hollywood." But he's the only major character returning for another round. That means David Fincher's follow-up with a script from Tarantino himself introduces a new ensemble of key characters, and one of them will instantly feel familiar in the film's opening sequence.

Without giving away any specific details of the flick, the Cliff Booth movie that critics are loving begins with Brad Pitt's character taking care of his duties as an employee at the New Beverly Cinema, a real-life Los Angeles movie-house that's now owned by Quentin Tarantino (though the theater in the movie is actually the Highland Theatre, owned by "Twilight" saga star Kristen Stewart). Booth keeps an eye on the film reels, refills the RC Cola syrup tank in the soda fountain, and closes up the theater when the credits roll on "Soul Brothers Die Hard!"
